name: flagship-sakura-yoru
description: Flagship theme sakura-yoru (cmux#47278), with its type set as settings for builds before the theme-file font keys.

files.themes/sakura-yoru.json:
// Sakura Yoru: cherry blossom at night. Plum-black glass over almond blossom against the sky,
// lantern-pink accent and a night-garden palette in every terminal. Copy it to
// ~/.config/cmux/themes/sakura-yoru.json (yours wins over this one), edit and save: the running app
// repaints at once, no relaunch.
{
  "name": "Sakura Yoru",
  "description": "Plum-black glass over blossom against the sky; lantern pink and moonlit teal.",

  // The terminal theme and its colors.
  "appearance.theme": "Rose Pine",
  "colors": {
    "background": "#1a0f17",
    "foreground": "#f6e3ec",
    "cursor": "#ff8fb8",
    "selection": "#4a2440",
    "accent": "#ff8fb8",
    "0": "#24141f",
    "1": "#ff5f87",
    "2": "#8fd19e",
    "3": "#f2c46d",
    "4": "#8fb3ff",
    "5": "#ff8fb8",
    "6": "#7fd6d0",
    "7": "#e8d2dc",
    "8": "#6e4f63",
    "9": "#ff87a5",
    "10": "#ade3b8",
    "11": "#f7d796",
    "12": "#b0c9ff",
    "13": "#ffb3cf",
    "14": "#a5e6e1",
    "15": "#fff5f9"
  },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  // The blossoms behind dark glass.
  "appearance.background": "van-gogh-almond-blossom",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 0.8,
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "glass",
  "appearance.glassTransparency": 0.3,

  // A plum sidebar with a hairline edge, its sections as lines with icons.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "card-outlined",
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#12090f",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 0.8,
  "sidebar.border": true,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "linesIcons",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#1a0f17",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 0.86,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#1a0f17",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 0.9,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#1a0f17",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 0.55,
  "browser.omnibar.glass": "regular",

  // Type: Folio's Hanken Grotesk in the chat, Menlo in the terminals.
  "agentPane.display.font.ui": "hanken",
  "terminal.fontFamily": "Menlo",
  "terminal.fontSize": 13,

  // Motion: a lantern-pink braille spinner, slow color drift.
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "braille",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#ff8fb8",
  "appearance.colorTransition.curve": "easeInOut",
  "appearance.colorTransition.duration": 450,

  "appearance.density": "cozy"
}
